flashpoints.spoken_why: Gold is a hedge against monetary credibility, so anything threatening the central bank goes to the heart of why people own it.
flashpoints.why_gold: The most underrated gold driver on this list. Gold is a hedge against monetary credibility, so anything that threatens the central bank's independence or the Treasury's standing goes to the heart of why the asset is owned at all.
flashpoints.counterweight: Nothing meaningful - this is one of the few themes where the haven bid and the rates channel push the same way.

flashpoints.escalation_markers: Explicit attempts to remove or pressure Fed officials, ratings actions, a failed or badly-covered auction, or a shutdown running long enough to delay official data.

geo.caveat: Each flashpoint is measured against its own trailing 30-day median, so a long-running conflict does not sit at maximum forever. This measures how loud a story is relative to its own normal - not what will happen.
